account.deleteGuideBody:
Deleting your account permanently removes the following, and it cannot be recovered.

• All registered pet profiles
• Medical records, appointments, vaccination records
• Health diaries, health metrics, daily care
• Community posts, comments, likes
• Care-sharing relationships
• Account info such as your nickname

※ App Store / Google Play subscriptions must be canceled separately. Deleting your account does not stop billing.
account.deleteConfirmBody: This action cannot be undone. Proceed anyway?
account.deleteFailBody: Please try again in a moment. If the problem persists, contact chaeon.studio@gmail.com.
